name: 文本压缩比
description: 使用 data compression algorithms 以测量 text redundancy and predictability as indicators of AI generation.
useCase: 检测AI生成文本 through lower information density and higher compressibility
mechanism: Compresses the input text using lossless algorithms (gzip, zlib, LZ77) and computes the 压缩比 (compressed size / original size). AI生成的 text typically compresses more efficiently due to higher regularity, more repetitive 模式, and lower information 熵 compared to 人类文本. The method also 分析 the 压缩比 of sliding windows 以检测 segments with varying compressibility—a sign of mixed human/AI authorship.
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80% on longer texts (>500 words)
source: Jiang, Z. et al. (2024) - Detecting LLM-Generated Text in Computing Education: A Comparative Study for ChatGPT Cases, IEEE Access
algorithm: Multi-Algorithm Compression + Ratio Analysis + Sliding Window Segmentation
parameters: Algorithms: gzip-9/zlib/brotli, Window: 200-500 chars sliding, Metrics: global ratio, segment ratios, ratio 方差, Min text: 200 words
strengths:
• 不需要训练数据 (unsupervised)
• Language and model agnostic
• Extremely fast computation
• Captures information-theoretic properties
limitations:
• Lower 准确度 on short texts
• Technical text with repeated terms compresses well naturally
• Depends on compression algorithm choice
• Not sensitive to semantic-level 模式

references.title: Jiang, Z. et al. (2024). Detecting LLM-Generated Text in Computing Education. IEEE Access.
Benedetto, D. et al. (2002). Language Trees and Zipping. Physical Review Letters.
Mireshghallah, F. et al. (2024). Smaller Language Models are Better Black-box Machine-Generated Text Detectors. EACL.
